quests.title: Vishaps and Where to Find Them
quests.description: Recently, a lot of unusual phenomena have been occurring all over Liyue. According to some, they may be related to a monster depicted in ancient texts, the Geovishap. Katheryne of the Liyue Adventurers’ Guild posted an urgent commission, calling adventurers to investigate the irregularities.
